name: Cloudflare Workers
summary: Cloudflare Workers runs code in V8 isolates on Cloudflare's global network, and the Agents SDK builds on it for hosting agents. Each agent is a Durable Object: a globally addressable, single-threaded instance with its own SQLite storage, WebSocket connections, scheduled tasks and recoverable execution. Tools such as sandboxes, a browser, web search, MCP and Workflows plug into the same platform.
facts: V8 isolates; agents are Durable Objects
Free plan (100k requests/day); Paid from $5/mo plus usage
goodFor: Many small, stateful agents (one per user or session)
Real-time chat and voice over WebSockets
Low idle cost with global placement
watchOut: Workers CPU and memory limits; heavy work needs containers or sandboxes
